notes.title: 🚨Bearly Escape - Big Update Coming Late July!
notes.notes:
The wild conclusion of Bearly Escape is almost here! 🧸

Final chapters with epic boss battles and hidden secrets

Smashable claw machines and teleporting puzzles

Discover the final story twist: What really happened between the doctor, the dog, and the gorilla?

More chaos. More surprises. You won’t want to miss it!

🔥Jump in now and see how far your bear can escape!

notes.title: Bearly Escape - June Update is Here! 🐾
notes.notes:
Hey Rescuers,

We’ve got a claw-some new update packed with crazy machines and smoother, wilder gameplay!🧸

✨ 2 new claw machine modes – shake it or use a magic wand!

✨ Use a magic wand to float and catch plushies mid-air

✨ 3 brand-new levels added – more fun, more chaos!

✨ Launch the bear from giant cannons to leap over traps

✨ Faster pace, better visuals, and upgraded animations!

🎯Stay tuned – more levels (up to 12!) and an epic final showdown are coming late July!
